evidence.why: Transport takes const bytes and byte length and returns mapped DSError.

reason: The direct typed wrapper passes payload and length to the transport and returns its status; synchronous describes the direct call, not a guarantee of physical delivery. No local buffer mutation occurs.

evidence.why: ACK construction and up-to-three send attempts.
External request retransmission, optional polling limit, reply validation and received-buffer release.

reason: Debugger ACK and request/reply callers establish the infrastructure role and external retry policy; wrapper contains only one unconditional call. UART denotes the interface, not an assertion of exclusive physical UART hardware.
